sermon.title: Illegal Sheep
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer continues on why sheep go astray: we turn to our own way, and “whoevers” cause little ones to stumble. From Matthew 18 he teaches conversion, baptism, humbling ourselves as children and serving, and that it is not the Father’s will that one little one perish. He applies this to children harmed crossing the border and around the world and calls the church to speak up.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check (unverified figures as spoken): 447 border deaths in 2012 (New York Times), 10% children; 1,000,000 crossings a year with 100,000 minors; 80% of girls raped; 100,000 children 7–12 exploited yearly (Organization of American States); people from 75 nations; 10,000 boys in Nigeria; border patrol rape and payola claims. Sensitive content kept as spoken: same-sex person told he was not saved without baptism; Hillary Clinton and the Democratic party “socialist”; Obama and Islam; Muslims believe in slavery; Prop 8 judge called homosexual; death penalty for drug selling, kidnapping, rape and trafficking; Black Lives Matter.

faqs.question: Can we blame others for going astray?
faqs.answer: No—each of us chose to disobey God’s word.

faqs.question: Is water baptism necessary?
faqs.answer: He told a man who had never been baptized that he wasn’t saved.

faqs.question: Is baptism only an outward expression?
faqs.answer: He says it is an inward promised work that kills the old sinful nature.

faqs.question: Why humble yourself like a child?
faqs.answer: A child is totally dependent on its parent, as we must be on God.

faqs.question: Can humiliation be useful?
faqs.answer: Yes—it gets our attention to do right, as with a corrected child.

faqs.question: Who is the greatest in the kingdom?
faqs.answer: The one who is last and servant of all.

faqs.question: What is the most important ministry?
Who causes little ones to stumble?
faqs.answer: Mostly parents, but also relatives, teachers or believers.

faqs.question: Should the church speak up for these children?
faqs.answer: Yes—he says the church should be a mouthpiece for innocent children.

faqs.question: What penalty does he call for sex trafficking?
faqs.answer: Death, with two witnesses and real proof.
